The '''rancor pygmy''' was a subspecies of [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]]<ref name="TNEGtAS" /> that lived on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and was smaller than normal rancors. Rancor pygmies were discovered on Dathomir after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Some [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineers]] claimed that they were an artificially engineered species that had escaped into the wild, but others disagreed with this theory based on the creature's genetics and breeding details. A fringe group also claimed that the rancor pygmies were the result of [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] magic, but this theory was generally discounted.<ref name="Sony" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> rancor pygmies were spotted in Nightsister territory and near the [[Forgotten Spire]].<ref name="Sony" />

A rancor pygmy was featured with a white-haired [[Human/Legends|Human]] woman and the slogan "See New Worlds!" on a recruitment poster for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="IR" />
